description: React component for a review form allowing users to add or edit reviews, including validation, accessibility features, and submission handling.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates form inputs, ensuring rating is between 1 and 5, and title and text are not empty.

methods.name: announce
methods.description: Updates live region with a message for accessibility, clears after 1.5 seconds.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, performs validation, calls onSubmit prop, and manages UI state.
